scope: Reference inventory of the SimplicityBRS launcher and recovery-media payload, not a claim these applications are installed on this host or their operations are validated.

launcher.name: File Manager
launcher.purpose: Browse files and copy backups to another drive.

launcher.name: Inspect disks
launcher.purpose: List disks using the launcher's fixed read-only DiskPart script; not partition editing.

launcher.name: Network information
launcher.purpose: Display adapter configuration; configuration alone does not prove connectivity.

launcher.name: Notepad++
launcher.purpose: Edit text files; portable payload recorded in apps/catalog.json.

launcher.name: Web browsers
launcher.purpose: Firefox and Chrome reported working in recovery-media tests. Edge failed in that environment; host Edge launch is separately verified.

launcher.name: BitLocker unlock panel
launcher.purpose: Inspect lock/key-protector information and help a user unlock with their recovery key. Never record or ask the model to handle the key. This pilot does not expose drive unlocking.

launcher.name: Command prompt
launcher.purpose: Advanced manual maintenance; no arbitrary command tool is exposed in this pilot.

lazesoft.edition: Recovery Suite Home 5.3.0.1, personal noncommercial use
lazesoft.location: Recovery media Programs/LazesoftHome; host installation not established
lazesoft.validation: User reported the suite opens in candidate 07. Individual backup, restore, clone, data-recovery and password workflows have not been validated. Do not automate their commit buttons.

modules.name: Data Recovery
modules.purpose: Search for deleted or lost files and recover selected files to a separate destination. Recovery is not guaranteed; avoid writing recovered data onto the source.

modules.name: Windows Recovery
modules.purpose: Boot and Windows recovery utilities. Establish the affected installation and backup before considering changes; current pilot cannot inspect offline Windows.

modules.name: Disk Image & Clone
modules.purpose: Create backup images, restore images, clone disks and manage partitions. Restore and clone can overwrite destination data. Source, destination, capacity and backup must be independently verified before any operation.

modules.name: Password Recovery
modules.purpose: Account/password recovery for an authorized owner. Not an exposed or validated pilot workflow.

automation_status: Reference/explanation only for recovery-media applications. General accessible desktop assistance is separately connected through Windows-MCP. No clone/restore/erase automation is enabled.
